card.name: Domain endings inside web addresses
card.fires_on: Pieces of a URL partway through, mainly the domain ending such as .org, .com, .gov or .edu, and nearby path pieces like a slash or .html. Mostly in citation or reference links.

modes.label: Domain endings in citation URLs
modes.description: The .org, .com, .gov or .edu piece after a site name inside a reference link.

modes.label: Other URL path pieces
modes.description: A slash or file ending partway through a long web address.
